title: A gate that speaks of a released coord claim, lease or key is not classed push
goal: bl_authority's push words leave out a release of a coord claim, lease or key (as without_benign_push_words already leaves out other benign wordings), so a doc or design question about a released claim is classed design while a release of the plugin or of a version stays push

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;it={'touches':['kb/_self/coordination.md']};c1=a.derived_class(it,{'id':'g1','question':'state that a released claim leaves no row, or add nothing?','options':['state it','add nothing']});c2=a.derived_class(it,{'id':'g2','question':'Which release of the plugin do we publish?','options':['a','b']});print(c1,c2);sys.exit(0 if c1=='design' and c2=='push' else 1)
